name: app-grey-user-flow-map-with-onboarding-phone
title: Grey User Flow Map with Onboarding Phone
whatItIs: A neutral grey page titled 'User Flow' with a dark onboarding container holding a phone, joined by lines to dark and outlined pill nodes (Sign Up, Login, Dashboard) branching to features that fade off the right edge.
whatItMeans: Solid vs. outlined pills separate main from secondary paths, and the fading branches imply a larger system without clutter.
techniques: Filled pills for primary screens, outlined for secondary
Branches fading and cropped at the right edge
One dark container to hold the entry screen
Thin grey connectors with small joint dots
Section number and plain title top-left

vocabulary.definition: A box or pill representing a screen or step in a flow.
Lines and nodes that fade toward the edge to suggest more.
Filled versus outlined styling to show priority.
